title: SpecDecode incremental KV cache & exact paths
protocol: Two frozen tiny models,24 fresh4-token prefixes;8 greedy outputs;three repeats; full recompute vs real single-layer cached K/V. k1/2/4 speculative target-path verification retained.
findings: K/V cache is exact per-layer inference, not caching final answers.
CPU timing only this environment; repeated timings are correlated and tiny models are overhead-sensitive.
Speculation remains deterministic greedy, not distribution-preserving random sampling.
scope: AI-assisted new local stress experiments; no retraining, external API, private data or production claim
